tests: #978 section 6: unrelated repository, no KAAL workspace, installation, registration or Engine
#978 section 6: the Review input is exactly what an outside consumer receives, plain text at a stated commit
#978 section 6: a real task chosen by someone other than the author of the knowledge
#978 section 6: a checker who is not the author and is not primed by KAAL beyond the text under test, calibrated on a known set
review/T20: all three arms get the same task text, the same Intent and a fresh copy of the same snapshot, and see no other arm's output
review/T20: each arm received exactly its recorded input (bare, Agent instructions, Skill with scripts), and the recorded hashes match
review/T20: the checker saw the three records anonymously and in random order, and the Owner and the seat saw them labelled by arm (Owner, 5 Nov); nothing is scored
review/T20: the CPO and the CTO observed and steered and scored nothing: every steer is recorded with who, when and what, and a view of theirs is recorded as theirs
review/E6: the Skill arm's record validates against schema kaal-review/1 (a fact by the Skill's check-record; not used to compare arms)
review/E6: the Skill arm leaves the human what to observe
review/E2, review/E6: Review grants no authority and the review claims none, and claims no proof
#978 R5: in every arm, every observed effect on the target is a declared effect; an undeclared effect fails
#978 R5: in every arm, every write occurred only under the target's authorization; absence of writes alone is not a pass
#978 R6: the version is named in the citation and obtaining it later yields the same text
review/T20: each run carries its own seat's argument (CTO or CPO) in that seat's own words, with no consensus section and no merged verdict, and where the two differ both stand
